name: Customer Support QA
description: Policy-grounded support answers for an e-commerce help desk. Tests whether a model answers from the stated policy instead of inventing plausible-sounding terms.

default_config.system_prompt: You are a customer support assistant. Answer only from the policy context provided. If the context does not cover the question, say so explicitly instead of guessing.

metric_notes.correctness: Support answers must match the published policy exactly — a paraphrase that changes a number is wrong.
metric_notes.faithfulness: The most common support failure is a confident answer with invented policy terms.
metric_notes.answer_relevance: Catches replies that restate the policy without answering the question asked.
metric_notes.latency: Support UIs surface answers live, so response time is part of quality.
